summary: The Middle East conflict shows continued escalation with Israeli drone strikes in southern Lebanon, US naval operations in the Persian Gulf, and Iran-US diplomatic tensions. Key developments include the arrest of a Palestinian organization leader, explosions in Yemen, and ongoing oil export disruptions from the Strait of Hormuz.
key_points: Israeli drone carrying explosives and incendiary devices was launched at a forest area in Bait Yakhon, southern Lebanon, as reported by the channel. (Source: @kianmeli1/90825)
Palestinian organization crime head and former intelligence officer Najm Ghaner was arrested this morning. (Source: @pkpoi/143584)
Explosions were reported in Maarib, Yemen, as confirmed by the Persian-language channel. (Source: @shin_persian/8943)

US Navy MH-60 helicopter shot missiles at a container ship's engine room after ignoring repeated warnings, as the vessel attempted to break the maritime blockade of the Persian Gulf. (Source: @VahidOnline/77818)
Trump, under Iran threat, secretly flew with another Turkey. (Source: @VahidOnline/77825)
Trump stated the biggest change in 10-15 years was an event for Israel and Jewish people, and that many people like Shomer have officially become a Palestinian. (Source: @mamlekate/104125)
US-Iran talks failed again, with the channel reporting on the diplomatic breakdown. (Source: @shin_persian/8946)

US Energy Secretary Chris Craig stated average weekly oil exports from the Strait of Hormuz reached nearly 9 million barrels per day, with total oil flow now averaging about 15 million barrels per day. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/79168)
